_envelope_comment: Derived from the Spokane-Spokane Valley, WA MSA COUNTY LIST, not from the observed venue bounding box. The observed bbox is only a LOWER bound — it says where the venues we happened to find are, not where the metro is, so an envelope cut to it would reject a legitimate future venue near the metro edge. Envelope = the union of the OSM boundary-polygon bounding boxes for the 3 MSA counties (Spokane, Stevens, Pend Oreille), Stevens (Washington), Pend Oreille (Washington)), rounded OUTWARD to 0.01 deg. Cross-check: contains all 24 geocoded venue(s) of 27 in this batch (observed lat 47.5979..47.8200, lng -117.4469..-117.0718).
msa: Spokane-Spokane Valley, WA (Spokane, Stevens, Pend Oreille counties)
